blocks.content:
The same data can tell very different stories depending on how it's displayed. A time series line chart shows trends over time, while a stat panel highlights a single current value. Choosing the right visualization makes your data easier to understand and act on.

Grafana organizes its visualizations into categories based on data type: graphs and charts for time-based data, stats and numbers for single values, and specialized formats for tables, logs, and other data types.
In the next milestone, you browse the visualization options in the panel editor.
